body:
## What to build

Report a locally known overlap between fixed keys and Grouping dimensions before acquiring metadata for an independent later typed selection. ADR 0005 requires locally decidable preparation errors before backend reads.

On main `978d7bef4247bf1348af5b90bfab47924db25500`, fix column a and begin a Grouping specification with a. With a later names-only selection, inspection reports that a cannot appear in both positions. Changing only that later selection to a type predicate causes a live DuckDB zero-row query before the same error. On a derived dtplyr input whose metadata cannot safely be obtained, the overlap is hidden by a metadata refusal recommending collection, although collection cannot make the overlap valid.

A 130-call public matrix covers all five constructors and the shared consumers. All 65 names-only controls report the overlap without metadata queries; typed cases expose 25 replaced dtplyr diagnostics and 15 actual DuckDB DBI invocations. Local typed controls retain the overlap diagnostic.

[Minimal replay, actual-query trace, matrix and causal analysis](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/49e1d16ff42ba33f776e25bc5e895d4296f24371/investigation/2026-11-02-summary-grouping-share-bug-hunt/grouping/README.md). Report mode exits zero and the contract assertion exits one. Tested with R 4.6.1, dtplyr 1.3.3, DuckDB 1.5.5 and dbplyr 2.6.0. Closed #1090 and merged #1120 were read with comments: they repaired invalid selections themselves; this residual failure concerns the plan-level overlap of already resolved values.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reject an already established fixed-key/Grouping-dimension overlap before an independent typed sibling can trigger metadata acquisition.
- [ ] Preserve the overlap diagnostic and caller column spelling on unsafe-metadata dtplyr inputs, and invoke no DuckDB metadata query for the established invalidity.
- [ ] Cover the shared preparation path through inspection and the supported Margin verbs, including the five constructor forms evidenced by the matrix.
- [ ] Retain valid typed selection behavior, existing leading-invalid-selection checks and ordinary selection evaluation semantics.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).
